Manchurian Instant Noodles
By: ravikumar
Published: Thursday, January 11, 2018 - 5:08am

Ingredients




1 Packet Ching's Secret Manchurian Instant Noodles
1 1/2 Cup (250ml) Water

Preparation

1 Step 1: 2 Boil 1 1/2 Cup (250ml) Water 3 Step 2: 4 Add noodles and the seasoning mix to the boiling water and cook for 2-3 mins. Stir Occasionally. 5 Serve Hot!

About

Manchurian Instant Noodles is one of the best and most Delicious Instant Noodles by Chings Secret, Chings is a popular Chinese brand in India and Have Verity of Product like Chings Schezwan instant noodles, Manchurian Instant Noodles and much more great Option to choose with. Chings Manchurian Instant Noodles is very good in taste and Delicious of food for dinner or tiffin. It is Desi Chinese Manchurian Instant Noodles Recipe to make and Served.
